method: Opened and read official primary references via web during this review; no restricted notebook or model route used.

references.title: Arduino analogRead
references.independentFinding: 10-bit codes 0–1023; 5/1024 quantization bin distinct from endpoint interpolation.

references.title: Arduino pulseIn
references.independentFinding: Timeout returns zero, not a physically verified zero range.

references.title: Legacy translated DHT11 manufacturer sheet
references.independentFinding: Introduction describes resistive humidity and NTC; exact pictured revision unresolved.

references.title: Adafruit DHT guide
references.independentFinding: Guide describes capacitive humidity sensing, thermistor and digital conversion; disagreement does not identify lecture device revision.

references.title: TDK MPU6500
references.independentFinding: Bare-IC 1.71–3.6 V supply and I2C/SPI; do not infer bare-chip 5 V tolerance from module table.

references.title: C++ execution sequencing
references.independentFinding: Separate full expressions sequence reads; operands of bitwise OR do not impose high-byte-first evaluation. No blanket undefined-behavior claim.

references.title: ST VL53L0X datasheet
references.independentFinding: Device ranging and I2C; fixed sensor is not by itself a rotating scan with world pose.

references.title: ST VL53L0X API manual
references.independentFinding: UM2039 Table1 on PDF p16: 0 valid; 1 Sigma Fail; only rejecting 4 is weaker than accepting only 0.

references.title: OpenCV VideoWriter
references.independentFinding: write requires the opened frame size; created-stream fps is not measured acquisition/inference throughput.

references.title: Ultralytics Open Images V7 guide
references.independentFinding: 601 configuration names, indexed 0–600; not a fresh checkpoint inspection or detection result.

savedMetadata.handling: Read configuration text and counted names only; embedded downloader not executed.
